basic_info.description: Atop Ashbury Heights, this one-of-a-kind inspiring home offers incredible panoramic views of SF's most notable landmarks, sweeping from the ocean/GGB to Downtown and the Bay Bridge. Designed by esteemed Sea Ranch architect, Joseph Escherick, this Mid-Century residence has been fully reimagined as a refined city sanctuary. The open floor plan with generous entertaining space boasts breathtaking vistas, while white oak floors and cathedral wood-beam ceilings create warmth throughout the living and dining areas. A clever built-in office, stylish bar, and wine storage allow seamless transitions from work to entertaining. The dining space opens to a remodeled kitchen with marble countertops and backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and skylight. Two spacious bedrooms include a primary suite with bay windows & en-suite bathroom dressed in marble and brass finishes. The home is complete with in-unit laundry, side by side garage parking, and ample closet/storage space. This boutique building features resort-style spaces with a panoramic view deck, fire pit, hot tub, dining/TV spot, BBQ/smoker, and a gym with Peloton. Tucked into a quiet cul-de-sac w/ stairs to Cole Valley, and minutes to multiple shopping & dining hot spots, this home offers both retreat style living and accessibility.
